title: **Qatar’s Foreign Minister: I don’t think the Strait of Hormuz will ever become unimportant.**
text:
**Qatar’s Foreign Minister: I don’t think the Strait of Hormuz will ever become unimportant.**"

"🔹 Earlier, Donald Trump had claimed that pipelines are being built across the Middle East so that there would no longer be any need to pass through the Strait of Hormuz, and his Treasury secretary had repeated this claim."

"🔸 Qatar’s foreign minister, however, pointed to the large volume of trade passing through this route and said: “You can’t say the Strait of Hormuz has become obsolete, because everything passes through it. In addition to oil and gas, a huge amount of global trade depends on this route.”
